---
name: Feature request
about: Propose new tracking, a new CLI/MCP capability, or a new integration
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What's missing**

What you're trying to do with nodewatch that you currently can't, or can only do awkwardly.

**Proposed shape**

A CLI command, a new field on an existing model, a new MCP tool — whatever form seems
natural. Doesn't need to be final; a sketch is enough to start the conversation.

**Alternatives considered**

Anything you tried instead (a `NODEWATCH_PRICING` override, post-processing exported JSON,
etc.), and why it wasn't quite enough.
